description: Synonymous-shuffle null test of the alternative-frame ORF in TMEM106A exon 6, mouse vs human
code:
import requests, json, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"gsdmd"})
ENS="https://rest.ensembl.org"
def ejson(p,t=4):
    for i in range(t):
        try:
            r=S.get(ENS+p,timeout=90,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
            if r.status_code==200: return r.json()
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(3)
    return None
bases="TCAG"; aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={a+b+c:aas[i] for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate([(x,y,z) for x in bases for y in bases for z in bases])}
def tr(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[i:i+3].upper(),"X") for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
SYN={}
for c,a in CODON.items(): SYN.setdefault(a,[]).append(c)

ex6={"mouse": ejson("/sequence/id/ENSMUSE00001226766?type=genomic;content-type=application/json")["seq"].upper(),
     "human": ejson("/sequence/id/ENSE00001627792?type=genomic;content-type=application/json")["seq"].upper()}

rng=np.random.default_rng(0); N=20000
nulls={}; summary=[]
for sp in ["mouse","human"]:
    s=ex6[sp]; codons=[s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,141,3)]
    alt=tr(s[2:]); real=alt.find("*")
    arr=np.empty(N,dtype=int)
    for n in range(N):
        shuf="".join(rng.choice(SYN[CODON[c]]) for c in codons)
        a=tr(shuf[2:]); L=a.find("*"); arr[n]= len(a) if L<0 else L
    nulls[sp]=arr
    summary.append(dict(species=sp, chimeric_frame_ORF_aa=real, null_median=int(np.median(arr)),
                        null_mean=round(float(arr.mean()),1),
                        p_synonymous_shuffle=round(float((arr>=real).mean()),5)))
sumdf=pd.DataFrame(summary); print(sumdf.to_string(index=False))

def ident(a,b):
    n=min(len(a),len(b)); return sum(x==y for x,y in zip(a[:n],b[:n]))/n
print(f"\nTMEM106A exon 6, mouse vs human (both 141 nt, ungapped):")
print(f"  nucleotide identity        = {ident(ex6['mouse'],ex6['human']):.3f}")
print(f"  native frame (+0) aa id    = {ident(tr(ex6['mouse']),tr(ex6['human'])):.3f}")
print(f"  chimeric frame (+2) aa id  = {ident(tr(ex6['mouse'][2:])[:44],tr(ex6['human'][2:])[:44]):.3f}  <- GSDMD-TMEM106A tail")
print(f"  control frame (+1) aa id   = {ident(tr(ex6['mouse'][1:])[:44],tr(ex6['human'][1:])[:44]):.3f}")
print("\n  mouse tail:", tr(ex6['mouse'][2:])[:44])
print("  human tail:", tr(ex6['human'][2:])[:44])
print("  match     :", "".join("|" if a==b else " " for a,b in zip(tr(ex6['mouse'][2:])[:44],tr(ex6['human'][2:])[:44])))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4),sharey=True)
for i,sp in enumerate(["mouse","human"]):
    ax[i].hist(nulls[sp],bins=np.arange(0,50),color="#9aa5b1",edgecolor="white")
    r=int(sumdf.chimeric_frame_ORF_aa[i]); p=float(sumdf.p_synonymous_shuffle[i])
    ax[i].axvline(r,color="#c2403d",lw=2)
    ax[i].text(r-1,ax[i].get_ylim()[1]*0.8,f"observed {r} aa\np = {p:.4f}",ha="right",color="#c2403d",fontsize=9)
    ax[i].set_title(f"{sp} TMEM106A exon 6",fontsize=10)
    ax[i].set_xlabel("ORF length in chimeric (+2) frame, codons")
ax[0].set_ylabel("synonymous shuffles (n = 20,000)")
fig.suptitle("Out-of-frame ORF in TMEM106A exon 6 exceeds the synonymous-shuffle null in both species",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
